name: Ore no Osananajimi ga Ero Haishin o Shiteita Ken ~Jimi na Kanojo no Ura no Kao wa EroEro na Haishinsha Deshita~
original_name: 俺の幼馴染がエロ配信をしていた件 ～地味な彼女の裏の顔はエロエロな配信者でした～
source:
In a word, normal.
The main character, Taichi, who leads such a peaceful school life, has one thing to look forward to that adds color to his daily life.

It is the live streaming of a certain streamer.
Taichi looks forward to her cheerful, joyful, and slightly naughty live-streaming of video games.

Then one day.
One day, while he was watching her live streaming as usual, he felt a small sense of discomfort.

"Could it be that this girl is......?"

I didn't know anything about her, but I was shocked to see the backstage face of my childhood friend.
And that was the beginning of everything.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1236519]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一句话，正常。
过着平静的学校生活的主人公太一，有一件值得期待的事情，为他的日常生活增添了色彩。

这是某个主播的直播。
太一期待她开朗、快乐、略带调皮的电子游戏直播。

然后有一天。
有一天，他像往常一样看着她的直播，心里有一丝不舒服。

“难道这个女孩是……？”

我对她一无所知，但当我看到我儿时好友在后台的面孔时，我感到很震惊。
这就是一切的开始。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1236519]Getchu[/url]]
